The BDCOM S2900-8T4X is a high-performance L3-Lite Managed Network Switch designed for enterprise networks, ISP infrastructure, data centers, and high-bandwidth networking environments. Featuring 8 × Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 ports and 4 × 10G SFP+ ports, this switch provides fast and reliable connectivity for modern network infrastructures.


With up to 128Gbps switching capacity and 72Mpps forwarding performance, the BDCOM S2900-8T4X delivers efficient traffic handling for demanding business and networking applications. Its advanced Layer 3-Lite features, VLAN support, QoS, ACL, IPv4/IPv6 capabilities, and 10G uplinks make it an excellent choice for network aggregation and enterprise deployments.


Key Features


  • 8 × 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit RJ45 Ethernet Ports
  • 4 × 10G/1G SFP+ Uplink Ports
  • L3-Lite Managed Switch
  • Up to 128Gbps Switching Capacity
  • Up to 72Mpps Forwarding Rate
  • 16K MAC Address Table
  • 9K Jumbo Frame Support
  • VLAN, QinQ and Link Aggregation Support
  • STP/RSTP/MSTP Support
  • Advanced ACL and QoS Features
  • IPv4/IPv6 Network Support
  • Static Routing and advanced Layer 3 features
  • SNMP, SSH, Telnet, HTTP/HTTPS Management
  • 19-inch 1U Rack-Mountable Design
  • Suitable for Enterprise, ISP and Data Center Networks
